issues.text: Before running ValeVision Cloud Sync ('all' or 'images') on any project with Layout Editor snapshots or scene thumbnails on R2, apply the W0-07 sync fix (execution/prepared/W0-07.patch): the live purge would delete 20 objects on 3047__Doous alone (DR-06).

Deploy order (DR-07): do not deploy the W0 renumber without the W0-08 service-worker package and one PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN bump; worker 1.6.0 (execution/prepared/W0-10.patch) needs your wrangler dev proof and deploy; nothing writes new R2 subfolder content until W0-07 is applied AND 1.6.0 is deployed.

Confirm Q-BACKUP (Flask save-guard backups at %LOCALAPPDATA%/ValeGardenHouses/ValeVision/ProjectDataBackups, keep 30) and answer DR-40 items 7-10 (gestures) so W3-04 can land; Section 2A of ValeVision__PLAN__TrueVisionPort__LayoutEditor__.md lists every default applied.

Commit guidance: W0-02's 81 renames are staged by git mv (intended); everything else is unstaged. Commit per wave from execution/checkpoints or by staging named paths; never git add -A at the repo root (other apps have unrelated changes).

Before deploying v2.71.2+ to the live site: in the read-only web viewer the session's first drawing fills in uncovered until W4-09 (TV skips the first-open veil in viewer mode). Either a one-line VV seam until W4-09 (drop '!Na__LeVw__IsViewerMode() && ' at the FirstOpen call) or hold the live deploy until W4-09. Localhost is unaffected.
Behaviour change to note: a stationary right or middle click on a door no longer opens/closes it (TV door module 1.8.0, DR-16 default); left click and taps still toggle.

Before deploying a W1 build: export the live project.json of every project with sheets; the first save after this release writes each sheet's restacked layer order (SheetRecords 1.39.0, RK-05). Visible DR-11 change: never-numbered sheets print D01 / {project}_D01 and their PDF names change (filename hunk lands with W3-16, OC-13).

OVH migration follow-up: the transport facade (W0-12) treats 'localhost' as the Flask host and everything else as R2/worker; on the VPS the same-origin Flask service is the production path, so the facade's host test needs replacing with a Flask-origin check when the VPS goes live. W0-07 (sync fix), W0-08 (shared service worker) and W0-10 (worker 1.6.0) are superseded; their staged copies under execution/prepared/ are reference only.
